description: What a customer pays for some lines on a day, and why, exactly as the order form and POST /api/v1/pricing/resolve price them: the customer's own lists, then its groups', then the tenant default list, each line at its own quantity and unit, then the best discount (none on a net list). Name the customer by customerId, customerEmail or exact customerName, or omit all three to price a sale with no customer. day is YYYY-MM-DD in the tenant's calendar; omit it for the tenant's today. Up to 500 lines, each an item (id or SKU), a quantity (default 1) and an optional uomId. Each line returns unitPrice, the discount, netUnitPrice and its source: the list and break it came from, or the item's own price. Read-only. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and a User.

day.description: Optional day to price on, YYYY-MM-DD in the tenant's calendar; omit for today.

quantity.description: How many, in the line's unit; greater than 0. Defaults to 1.

uomId.description: Optional sell unit id (GUID, from list_uoms); omit for the item's base unit.
